children: The GTA launch is drawing a wave of crypto scams, including fake PlayStation Store pages, phony token airdrops and wallet-draining pre-order sites, according to security firm Blockaid.
Fake Storefronts Mimic PlayStation To Drain Wallets
Blockaid found a near-perfect PlayStation Store clone selling "Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition" for $89.99.
Clicking "Pre-Order" opens a wallet-connect window listing TronLink, Trust Wallet, WalletConnect, Bybit, OKX, Bitget, TokenPocket, imToken and Ledger, but every option routes to the same drainer kit.
Dozens of other GTA-themed sites run the same playbook under domains like rockstoregta6.com, gta6shop.shop and gta6airdrop.site, dangling pre-orders, "Ultimate Editions" or launch-day airdrops.
Blockaid traced 451 near-identical lure posts from 116 X accounts feeding traffic to these pages, with scam activity accelerating through October as the release date approached.
Thousands Of Fake GTA Tokens Are Flooding Solana
Blockaid detected more than 20,000 GTA-named tokens on
Solana
between July and November, flagging over 8,800 of them as malicious, a warning or spam, with smaller batches also turning up on Base and
Ethereum
Most exist purely as bait, often paired with social posts that point to an unrelated, legitimate token as fake proof of credibility.
One victim found that out the hard way. After the buyer purchased GTA6DOG on
Uniswap
on Nov. 3, the deployer called a contract function that bypassed wallet approval and sent the buyer’s entire 271,031-token balance to a burn address about a minute later.
Blockaid flagged the token as high risk within an hour of its first scan, well before most buyers caught on.
How To Avoid Getting Scammed
Buy the game only through Rockstar, the
Take-Two Interactive
studio behind GTA 6, or official PlayStation, Xbox and Steam storefronts, none of which accept crypto or ask you to connect a wallet
Treat any "check your eligibility" prompt as a red flag, since no official GTA token or airdrop exists
Keep a separate, low-balance wallet for anything new rather than connecting your main holdings
Don’t trust familiar logos in a wallet-connect pop-up, since fake windows copy real brands like Trust Wallet and Ledger

title: Buying GTA 6? Scammers Clone PlayStation Store to Steal Your Crypto
